general_information.Description: This course provides an introduction to ordinary differential equations with applications. Topics include first-order, linear higher-order, and systems of differential equations; series solutions; Laplace transforms; and stability of nonlinear differential equations. Upon completion, students should be able to use differential equations to model real-life phenomena, solve the equations, and use the solutions to analyze the phenomena.
general_information.StudentTasks: Students must attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination.
general_information.Tools: - Audio CD đi kèm Main textbook (CMS) - Nhập môn Kana (Bộ môn tổng hợp và biên soạn, phát cho sinh viên trong quá trình học) Only for Instructors: - Dekiru Nihongo - Beginner Level: Kanji Tamago - Dekiru Nihongo – Beginner Level: A Teaching Guide with Illustrations - Tài liệu phụ trợ khác (Shin Nihongo no Kiso, Mainichi Kikitori...) Other references/resources - Teacher's Presentation Powerpoints (CMS) - Basic Kanji I - Shin Nihongo no Kiso - Internet & CMS

assessments.No Question: 5-25 (At least 5*n questions where n is the number of Chapters covered in the test.)
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Current chapter(s) Each Progess Test covers at least 01 Chapter and at most 03 Chapters, and overall they must cover all learned Chapters of the course.
assessments.Grading Guide: by instructor, and by suitable means (computer, paper, oral...)
assessments.Note: Instruction and shedules for Progress tests must be presented in the Course Implementation Plan approved by director of the campus. assessments.Grading Guide: guided by instructor in class, completed by student at home, submitted by deadline
